experimental_procedure: 2-Iodo-3-methyl-2-butene. A 50 mL Schlenk tube was charged with CuI (382 mg, 2.01 mmol, 5.0 mol%), NaI (9.00 g, 60.0 mmol), evacuated and backfilled with argon. N,N'- Dimethylethylenediamine (426 μL, 4.00 mmol, 10 mol%), 2-bromo-3-methyl-2-butene (4.65 mL, 40.1 mmol), and n-butanol (20 mL) were added under argon. The Schlenk tube was sealed with a Teflon valve and the reaction mixture was stirred at 120 °C for 24 h. The resulting tan suspension was allowed to reach room temperature, poured into pentane (200 mL) and washed with a solution of 30% aq ammonia (10 mL) in water (200 mL), followed by water (3×200 mL). The organic phase was dried (MgSO4) and concentrated to ~10 mL volume. The residue was distilled collecting the fraction boiling at 120-140 °C to give 6.08 g (77% yield) of 2-iodo-3-methyl-2-butene as a colorless liquid (>95% pure). The 1H spectrum matched the one reported by Sherrod, et al.19 2-Iodo-3-methyl-2-butene. 6.08 g (77% yield). 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ 135.9, 93.2, 31.4, 30.3, 18.9.

General/Typical Procedure: Typical Procedures for F/I exchange of secondary and tertiary alkyl fluorides. A typical procedure is given for the synthesis of 2d. To a hexane (2.5 mL) were added Et3Al (1.0 M in hexane, 0.5 mL, 0.5 mmol) and CH2I2 (80 μl, 2 mmol), then the reaction mixture was stirred for 90 min. (Active species was generated and 1-iodoethane was formed as byproduct.) After the reaction mixture was cooled to-30 °C, 2-fluorododecane 2a (94 mg, 0.5 mmol) was added and stirred for 30 min at the same temperature. The reaction was quenched with 3 M aqueous HCl solution slowly and extracted with hexane. The organic phase was filtered through a short pad of silica gel. The solvents and volatile compounds were removed under reduced pressure. Iodocyclohexane (3d). The compound 3d was prepared with Et3Al (1.0 M in hexane, 1 mL, 1 mmol), CH2I2 (0.16 mL, 2 mmol) and fluorocyclohexane 3a (0.11 mL, 1 mmol). The reaction gave a mixture of iodocyclohexane 3d and elimination side product (cyclohexene). NMR yield: 94%. CAS Registry Number [626-62-0]. 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ 1.35-1.44 (m, 3H), 1.61-1.70 (m, 3H), 1.91-2.01 (m, 2H), 2.11-2.19 (m, 2H), 4.32-4.39 (m, 1H). 13C{1H} NMR (101 MHz, CDCl3): δ 25.2, 27.3, 32.8, 39.6.

General/Typical Procedure: Preparation of propionic acid-(R)-3-iodoethyl-1-phenethylbut-3-enyl ester. To a stirring solution of the ester (116.9 mg, 0.416 mmol, 1.00 eq) and acetone (4.2 mL, 0.10 M) in a 25 mL round-bottom flask at room temperature was added NaI (1.25 g, 8.32 mmol, 20 eq). The mixture was kept at room temperature in the dark for 24 h and then diluted with Et2O (15 mL). The mixture was filtered through a plug of Celite®, the filtrate was diluted with Et2O (50 mL) and filtered through the same plug of Celite®. The filtrate was concentrated under reduced pressure and the residue was purified by flash chromatography on a 1.5 x 18 cm silica gel column eluting with a solvent gradient of 2.5% (100 mL) through 5% EtOAc/hexanes (100 mL). The eluant was collected in 10 mL portions and the product containing fractions (6 to 12) were combined and concentrated. (R)-3-iodomethyl-1-phenethyl-but-3-enyl ester as a clear colorless oil, yield 254 mg, 0.604 mmol, 100%.
